To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

humanistic quality is the key factor in the development of a college student and that application-oriented universities should pay attention to the development of humanistic quality in their education.

humanistic quality-oriented education is the key to cultivation of humanistic qualities in application-oriented universities, and the cultivation of humanistic values should focus on the improvement of language application abilities of students.

humanistic quality-oriented education is a kind of education that aims to cultivate college students’ comprehensive development,including development of emotions,morality,sense of responsibility,culture and values,etc.,while application-oriented universities should pay attention to both humanistic quality-oriented educations and practicality.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cultivation of humanistic qualities of students in application-oriented universities.
the cultivation of humanistic qualities of college students in application-oriented universities.

cultivation of humanistic qualities and language application ability of application-oriented universities,which will be of great significance for improving quality of application-oriented universities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
application-oriented universities should cultivate students with both humanistic quality and professional skills.
the cultivation of humanistic qualities should be emphasized and improved in application-oriented universities.
application-oriented universities should emphasize both practicality and humanistic quality-oriented education.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we should not only pay more attention to cultivation of humanistic qualities but also pay more attention to practicality.

application-oriented universities should emphasize cultivation of humanistic qualities and application-oriented qualities at the same time,which can help college students develop their potential and improve their comprehensive qualities.
we have to improve the quality of application-oriented university education and cultivate humanistic quality of students.
The main takeaway from our work is that
application-oriented universities should pay more attention to the cultivation of college students’humanistic quality.

application-oriented universities need to cultivate humanistic quality of college students through education of humanism,emotion,ethics,professional ethics and social ethics,which will help college students become more practical and more competitive.
humanistic quality-oriented education should be emphasized and improved in application-oriented universities,so that the students can develop in an all-round way.
